text: The paper states that a question may be decomposable without looking at the whole context, which lets Iterated Amplification apply to tasks whose context is too large for a human expert to observe directly. H is given the ability to look at small parts of the context, ideally decomposing until subquestions depend only on isolated facts.
title: Decomposing questions over contexts too large for the expert to observe
